name: MonarchMyStatus
title: MyStatus
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row with Modifier.clickable (Role.Button, Material 3 ripple) around MonarchAvatar with its presence dot and two androidx.compose.material3.Text lines; a LaunchedEffect with kotlinx.coroutines.delay that redraws when the status ends
summary: The signed-in person's avatar, presence and custom status, as one row that opens their status settings.
whenToUse: At the top of a navigation drawer, an account screen or a workspace switcher, where people check and change their own status.
whenNotToUse: Not for other people (use MonarchAvatar with a status, or MonarchMemberRow). Not for the account menu itself.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchMyStatus(name: String, presence: MonarchPresenceStatus, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, image: Painter? = null, customStatus: MonarchMyStatusCustomStatus? = null, now: Long? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchMyStatusLabels = MonarchMyStatusLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
public data class MonarchMyStatusCustomStatus(text: String? = null, emoji: String? = null, until: Long? = null)
public class MonarchMyStatusLabels(hint: String? = null, setStatus: String? = null, presence: ((MonarchPresenceStatus) -> String)? = null)

options.name: name
options.description: The person's display name, already localised. Also the avatar's initials.

options.name: presence
options.description: Online, away, busy, do not disturb or offline. Drawn as the avatar's presence dot and read in words.

options.name: onClick
options.description: Opens the status settings, usually a MonarchBottomSheet the app shows.

options.name: image
options.description: The avatar picture, loaded by the app; null shows the initials.

options.name: customStatus
options.description: The person's own message and emoji, with an optional until time in epoch milliseconds after which it is hidden.

options.name: now
options.description: The time until is compared with, in epoch milliseconds. Without it the row reads the clock and redraws itself when the status ends; pass it for a fixed rendering.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the row can be pressed.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the click action, the "Set a status" invitation and the presence names.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The interaction source of the row.

states.name: custom status
states.description: The emoji and message under the name, in the muted text color.

states.name: presence only
states.description: Without a status, away, busy and do not disturb are written under the name.

states.name: no status
states.description: Online or offline without a status shows "Set a status" in the subtle text color.

states.name: expired
states.description: A status whose until has passed is hidden, at that moment, without the app doing anything.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The row cannot be pressed and TalkBack reads it as disabled.

appearance: A small avatar with its presence dot, the name in the strong body style and a caption line under it in the muted text color (subtle for the invitation), on no background; pressing shows the ripple. All colors are theme roles, so dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same parameters as iOS, with the Android conventions: the picture is a Painter the app loads, until and now are epoch milliseconds, and the action is onClick. The web renders a link with href or a button; on Android the row is always a button and the app navigates or opens a sheet in onClick. The web reads "Your status and settings" before the name; on Android that is the click action label, read by TalkBack as "Double tap to open your status and settings". iOS redraws with a TimelineView; Android waits with a LaunchedEffect until the status ends.
accessibility: The row is one TalkBack button named by the person's name.
Its state description is the presence and the status line, such as "Online, 🌴 On holiday", or just the presence when the line is the presence.
Its click action label is "open your status and settings".
The presence is always in words, so it never depends on the dot's color; the avatar is decorative.
The row is at least 48dp high and its text wraps at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: A status made of spaces is treated as no status.
An emoji without a message shows the emoji alone.
An until in the past hides the status at once.

examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space1)) {
    MonarchMyStatus(
        name = {{people.0.name}},
        presence = MonarchPresenceStatus.{{people.0.presence|pascal}},
        onClick = {},
        customStatus = MonarchMyStatusCustomStatus(text = {{people.0.customStatus.text}}, emoji = {{people.0.customStatus.emoji}}),
        now = {{now|millis}},
    )
    MonarchMyStatus(
        name = {{people.1.name}},
        presence = MonarchPresenceStatus.{{people.1.presence|pascal}},
        onClick = {},
        now = {{now|millis}},
    )
    MonarchMyStatus(
        name = {{people.2.name}},
        presence = MonarchPresenceStatus.{{people.2.presence|pascal}},
        onClick = {},
        now = {{now|millis}},
    )
}
